def: to end (in the sense of completion or failure)
kjv: cease, come to an end, fail, perfect, perform.

occurrences.text: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
Help, Lord; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
The Lord will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
